description: Tennessee has no state minimum wage, meaning the federal rate of $7.25 per hour applies. Meanwhile, the MIT Living Wage Calculator estimates that a single adult in Tennessee needs at least $21.99 per hour to cover basic expenses, and far more for households with children. Costs such as food, housing, healthcare, and transportation continue
paid_for_by: Paid for by Teri Mai for Tennessee House District 92, Rebecca Strothers, Treasurer
title: Establish a Livable Wage - Teri Mai for Tennessee House District 92
